name: Prompt Motion
summary: Gallery of motion videos made with Claude Opus 5.5, each shown with the prompt or skill that produced it.
description: A browsable collection of AI-made motion videos, each credited to its creator (@handles) and paired with the prompt or the skill behind it; a filter switches between prompt-based and skill-based entries. Includes writable prompt templates (a 3D template and a showreel prompt) and a free customizer that rewrites any prompt with your subject, format and colours in the browser.
contains: motion videos made with Claude Opus 5.5, each with its prompt or skill
filter between prompt and skill entries
prompt templates: the 3D template and the showreel prompt
free prompt customizer that runs in the browser
email digest of new videos and prompts
